question: The SEVA app was launched by which of the following ministers to track coal dispatch?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** SEVA App:- **

 
 
• The SEVA app was launched in 2018 as a part of the Digital India initiative.
 
• **It is a mobile app that allows users to track the dispatch of coal from Coal India Limited (CIL) to power plants.**
 
• The app provides information on the quantity of coal dispatched, the date of dispatch, and the mode of transport.
 
• **The SEVA app was launched by Piyush Goyal, the Union Minister of State (IC) for Power, Coal, New & Renewable Energy and Mines.**
 
• The SEVA app is aimed at increasing transparency and accountability in the coal dispatch process.
 
• It also helps to ensure that power plants have a reliable supply of coal, which is essential for uninterrupted power generation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Vilas Paswan:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian politician who served as the Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution in the Union Cabinet of India from 2014 to 2020. **
 
• He was the founder and president of the Lok Janshakti Party (LJP), a political party in India that represents the interests of the Dalit community.
 
 
 
• **Nitin Gadkari:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who is the current Minister for Road Transport & Highways in the Government of India. **
 
• He is also the longest serving Minister for Road Transport & Highways currently running his tenure for over 9 years.
 
• Gadkari earlier served as the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) from 2009 to 2013.
 
• He is also known for his work as the Public Works Department Minister of the State of Maharashtra, where, under his leadership, a series of roads, highways and flyovers across the state were constructed.
 
 
 
• **Suresh Prabhu:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician and Chancellor of Rishihood University. **
 
• He served as the Minister of Civil Aviation, Railways, and Commerce & Industry in the First Modi ministry.
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
